name: crashlytics-sourcemaps
description: Next.js app built with CRASHLYTICS_UPLOAD_MAPPING=true. Crashlytics source-map upload isn't available on Cloud Run yet, so the adapter ignores the variable (with a build-log warning) and doesn't turn on browser source maps: no .js.map files under .next/static, and no client chunk's source map is served. The upload itself is a known gap.

manualChecks.name: crashlytics-sourcemap-upload
manualChecks.description: Known gap: Crashlytics source-map upload during the build isn't available on Cloud Run yet. Once it ships, check that the maps reach Crashlytics (needs a live Firebase Web App ID and project credentials) and are removed from the image.
